items.objective: Commit related approval fields atomically and resolve a retry to the same committed approval.
items.fact: Each submission carries a stable request ID reused on retry; the retry after commit must return the existing approval with its exception and required control evidence.
items.nearest: A status-first or client-display workflow can expose partial state and cannot resolve a retry to the committed approval.
items.changed: The visible request-identity fact and accepted operation now cover the already stated no-duplicate retry condition; the correct option meaning changes and receives a fresh stable ID.
sourceRefs: Fictional case contract stated in revised prompt; no external exactly-once or transport claim.
